# Subnautica 2 Guide

Subnautica 2 Guide is the ultimate fan resource for Subnautica 2, the upcoming underwater survival game from Unknown Worlds Entertainment. We provide maps, creature guides, crafting recipes, release date tracking, and FAQs.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://subnautica2.live/ — Subnautica 2 news, guides, and resources
- Map: https://subnautica2.live/map — Interactive map of the game world
- Items: https://subnautica2.live/items — Item database and locations
- Blueprints: https://subnautica2.live/blueprints — Crafting blueprints
- Creatures: https://subnautica2.live/creatures — Creature database and guides
- Guides: https://subnautica2.live/guides — Gameplay guides and tutorials

## Key Facts

- Subnautica 2 is the sequel to Subnautica (2018) and Subnautica: Below Zero (2021)
- Developed by Unknown Worlds Entertainment
- Expected platforms: PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S
- Genre: Underwater survival adventure
- Features: Open world, base building, creature taming, multiplayer co-op
